tagline.zh: 鏡頭下的骨盆，門診裡的頭暈
tagline.en: A pelvis through the scope, a faint in the clinic

desc.zh: 腹腔鏡的第二雙手、病房與門診的第一線。你問病史、看超音波、寫計畫、回電話。
desc.en: Second pair of hands at the laparoscope, first line for the ward and the clinic. You take histories, scan, write plans and return calls.

desc.zh: 器械桌是你的國土。鏡頭、氣腹管、子宮鏡的灌流液，還有每一次清點。
desc.en: The instrument trolley is your territory: the camera, the gas line, the hysteroscopy fluid and every count.

about.zh: 腹腔鏡的手很穩，呼叫器永遠在她講到重點的時候響。口頭禪：「鏡頭先置中。」
about.en: Steady hands at the laparoscope; her pager always goes off mid-sentence. Catchphrase: 'Centre the camera first.'

about.zh: 沉默，但對血紅素很有意見。貧血沒矯正，他不簽。
about.en: Quiet, with strong opinions about haemoglobin. Uncorrected anaemia and he does not sign.

about.zh: 手術室的記憶體。哪一支鏡頭在修、哪一盒縫線快沒了，問她就對了。
about.en: Theatre's memory. Which scope is in for repair, which suture box is nearly empty: ask her.

about.zh: 三十二歲國小老師，經痛痛了十年，被說成「忍一下就好」。今天來看清楚，也想知道還能不能懷孕。
about.en: Thirty-two, primary-school teacher, ten years of period pain she was told to 'put up with'. Today she wants to see what is there, and whether she can still have a baby.

about.zh: 四十六歲，市場賣菜，知道自己有肌瘤三年了。這次流了十天，今天在門診站起來就頭暈。
about.en: Forty-six, sells vegetables at the market, has known about her fibroids for three years. Bleeding for ten days this time; stood up in clinic today and the room spun.

about.zh: 三十八歲會計師，黏膜下肌瘤，每個月都要請兩天假。今天下午排子宮鏡切除。
about.en: Thirty-eight, accountant, a submucosal fibroid that costs her two days' leave a month. Hysteroscopic resection this afternoon.

about.zh: 門診的眼睛。病人臉色一白，她就先把人扶到床上，再打電話。
about.en: The clinic's eyes. One pale face and she has the patient on the couch before she dials.

about.zh: 夜班。數衛生棉的數量比數羊還認真。
about.en: Night shift. Counts pads more carefully than most people count sheep.

plain.zh: 子宮內膜的組織長到子宮外面，每個月跟著出血、發炎、沾黏，造成經痛和不孕。
plain.en: Tissue like the womb lining growing outside the womb, bleeding and inflaming each month, causing pain, scarring and infertility.

plain.zh: 肚皮上幾個小洞，放鏡頭和細長器械進去看和開刀。
plain.en: A few small cuts in the abdomen for a camera and long thin instruments to look and operate.

plain.zh: 把二氧化碳打進腹腔撐出空間，鏡頭才看得到。
plain.en: Carbon dioxide blown into the abdomen to make room for the camera to see.

plain.zh: 腹腔鏡後殘留的氣體刺激橫膈，痛會「轉移」到肩膀。幾天就好。
plain.en: Gas left after laparoscopy irritates the diaphragm and the pain is 'referred' to the shoulder. It settles in days.

plain.zh: 異常子宮出血的分類口訣：前四個是結構性原因，後五個不是。
plain.en: The mnemonic for classifying abnormal uterine bleeding: four structural causes, then five that are not.

plain.zh: 月經量多到影響生活：每一兩小時就要換、有血塊、會頭暈。
plain.en: Periods heavy enough to affect life: changing every hour or two, clots, feeling faint.

plain.zh: 長在子宮最內層、突進子宮腔的肌瘤。體積不大也會造成大量出血。
plain.en: A fibroid in the innermost layer, bulging into the cavity. Even a small one can bleed heavily.

plain.zh: 肌瘤依位置從零到八編號。數字越小越靠近子宮腔，越可能造成出血。
plain.en: Fibroids numbered zero to eight by position. The lower the number, the closer to the cavity and the more likely to bleed.

plain.zh: 從陰道經子宮頸放進細鏡頭看子宮腔，可以直接切除腔內的肌瘤或息肉。
plain.en: A thin camera passed through the cervix to see inside the womb, able to remove fibroids or polyps in the cavity directly.

plain.zh: 子宮鏡用液體撐開子宮腔。進去多少、出來多少，差額太大就要停。
plain.en: Hysteroscopy distends the cavity with fluid. What goes in minus what comes out; too large a gap and you stop.

plain.zh: 把病人的血和血庫的血先配對，萬一需要輸血可以馬上拿到。
plain.en: Matching the patient's blood against bank blood in advance so it is ready the moment it is needed.

plain.zh: 劃刀前全隊停下來，核對病人、部位、手術名稱和備血。
plain.en: Before the incision the whole team stops to confirm patient, site, operation and blood.

plain.zh: 手術前後數清楚每一件器械、紗布和縫針。
plain.en: Counting every instrument, swab and needle before and after.

text.zh: 螢幕、光源、鏡頭主機和氣腹機疊成一座塔。鏡頭先置中，再做任何事。
text.en: Screen, light source, camera unit and insufflator stacked in one tower. Centre the camera before anything else.

text.zh: 打二氧化碳撐開腹腔的機器。壓力依醫囑設定，數字異常先想管路。
text.en: The machine that blows carbon dioxide into the abdomen. Pressure per protocol; an odd number usually means the tubing.

text.zh: 細鏡頭加進水、出水兩條管路。刷手護理師負責記灌流液差額。
text.en: A thin scope with inflow and outflow lines. The scrub nurse keeps the fluid-deficit tally.

text.zh: 經腹和經陰道兩種探頭。先經腹看全貌，再看細節。
text.en: Transabdominal and transvaginal probes. The big picture first, then the detail.

text.zh: 小芸骨盆裡那幾個深藍色的小點，切下來送病理確認。
text.en: The small dark-blue spots from Hsiao-Yun's pelvis, excised and sent to pathology for confirmation.

text.zh: 息肉、腺肌症、肌瘤、惡性；凝血、排卵、內膜、醫源性、未分類。先分類，再治療。
text.en: Polyp, adenomyosis, leiomyoma, malignancy; coagulopathy, ovulatory, endometrial, iatrogenic, not classified. Classify first, then treat.

text.zh: 從藥物到子宮內投藥系統、子宮鏡、栓塞、切除，一階一階上。貧血先矯正。
text.en: From medication to the intrauterine system, hysteroscopy, embolisation and hysterectomy, one rung at a time. Correct anaemia first.

guide.en: Check the list at the board

lines.zh: 白板：第一台小芸，腹腔鏡；第二台林小姐，子宮鏡肌瘤切除。角落有人寫了「門診今天滿」。
lines.en: Board: first case Hsiao-Yun, laparoscopy; second Ms Lin, hysteroscopic myomectomy. In a corner someone has written 'clinic full today'.

lines.zh: 早。腹腔鏡塔的二號鏡頭送修了，今天用一號。氣腹機昨天校正過。
lines.en: Morning. Scope two is in for repair; we are on scope one today. The insufflator was calibrated yesterday.

lines.zh: 收到。小芸的同意書我去確認。
lines.en: Noted. I will confirm Hsiao-Yun's consent.

lines.zh: 早。小芸的腹腔鏡，你進去第一件事看什麼？
lines.en: Morning. Hsiao-Yun's laparoscopy: once you are in, what do you look at first?

lines.zh: 鏡頭先置中，然後骨盆巡視：子宮、兩側卵巢輸卵管、後穹窿、腹膜。
lines.en: Centre the camera first, then a pelvic survey: uterus, both tubes and ovaries, the pouch of Douglas, the peritoneum.

lines.zh: 好。她的目標不只是止痛，還有生育。手術的每一刀都要記得這件事。
lines.en: Good. Her goal is not only pain relief but fertility. Every move in there should remember that.

lines.zh: 呼叫器響了。葉主治看了一眼，塞回口袋。
lines.en: Her pager goes. Dr Yeh glances at it and tucks it away.

lines.zh: 醫師，我痛了十年，大家都說忍一下。你們今天真的會看到什麼嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, ten years of pain and everyone said put up with it. Will you actually see something today?

lines.zh: 我們會把整個骨盆看一遍，找到的我們處理，也會拍照給你看。
lines.en: We will look over the whole pelvis, treat what we find, and show you the pictures afterwards.

lines.zh: 還有……我還能懷孕嗎？
lines.en: And... can I still get pregnant?

lines.zh: 這是今天最重要的問題之一。手術後葉主治會跟你好好談。
lines.en: That is one of today's most important questions. Dr Yeh will talk it through with you after.

guide.en: Power up and check the tower

lines.zh: 光源、白平衡、對焦、氣腹管接好、沖洗吸引。一樣一樣來。
lines.en: Light source, white balance, focus, gas line connected, irrigation and suction. One at a time.

lines.zh: 一號鏡頭影像清楚。氣腹管接好了。
lines.en: Scope one is clear. Gas line on.

lines.zh: 刷手、穿袍、戴手套。小芸已經睡著，江醫師點頭。
lines.en: Scrub, gown, gloves. Hsiao-Yun is asleep; Dr Chiang nods.

lines.zh: 各位，時間暫停。
lines.en: Everyone, time-out.

lines.zh: 小芸，腹腔鏡骨盆探查與內膜異位病灶處理，保留生育功能，無過敏，備血不需。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yun, laparoscopic pelvic survey and treatment of endometriosis, fertility-sparing, no allergies, no blood required.

post.zh: 麻醉無疑慮。氣腹打起來的時候我會看呼吸道壓力。
post.en: No anaesthetic concerns. I will watch the airway pressure when the gas goes in.

lines.zh: 氣腹建立了。鏡頭給你。先置中，再巡視。
lines.en: Pneumoperitoneum is up. The camera is yours. Centre it, then survey.

post.zh: 看到了嗎？後穹窿那幾個深藍色的點，還有左卵巢後面的沾黏。
post.en: See them? The dark-blue spots in the pouch of Douglas, and the adhesions behind the left ovary.

guide.en: What to do at the scope

lines.zh: 找到病灶之後呢？切除還是燒灼？卵巢怎麼辦？你說。
lines.en: Now that you have found it: excise or ablate? And the ovary? Your call.

post.zh: 對。能切除就切除送病理，卵巢盡量保留組織。她想要的是孩子，不是漂亮的照片。
post.en: Yes. Excise and send what you can; spare ovarian tissue. She wants a child, not a pretty picture.

lines.zh: 關腹前器械清點。紗布、縫針、腹腔鏡器械的每一個小零件。
lines.en: Count before closure. Swabs, needles, every small part of the laparoscopic instruments.

lines.zh: 紗布數對、縫針數對、器械完整。器械清點正確。
lines.en: Swabs correct, needles correct, instruments complete. Instrument count correct.

lines.zh: 放氣的時候盡量把氣排乾淨，她明天的肩膀會感謝你。
lines.en: Let as much gas out as you can; her shoulders will thank you tomorrow.

guide.zh: 寫手術紀錄與拍照存檔

lines.zh: 你把腹腔鏡的照片存進病歷：巡視的每一個角落、病灶的位置、處理前後。
lines.en: You save the laparoscopy photos into the chart: every corner of the survey, lesion sites, before and after.

lines.zh: 呼叫器又響了。這次是門診。
lines.en: The pager again. This time it is the clinic.

note.zh: 黃太太評估完成，計畫確定

lines.zh: 醫師，黃太太，四十六歲，肌瘤病史，這次月經流了十天。剛剛站起來頭暈，臉很白。我先讓她躺下了。
lines.en: Doctor, Mrs Huang, forty-six, known fibroids, bleeding ten days this cycle. Went dizzy on standing just now, very pale. I have her lying down.

lines.zh: 做得對。平躺、量姿勢性血壓、建立靜脈路徑、抽血加配血。我請人把她送上來超音波。
lines.en: Right call. Flat, postural pressures, a line in, bloods with a cross-match. I will have her brought up for a scan.

guide.zh: 接黃太太，先問出血型態
guide.en: Meet Mrs Huang; ask about the bleeding

lines.zh: 醫師，我以為流久一點就會停。市場早上很忙，真的走不開。
lines.en: Doctor, I thought it would stop if I waited. The market is busy in the mornings; I really could not leave.

lines.zh: 我知道。先讓我問清楚這次是怎麼流的。
lines.en: I understand. First let me ask exactly how the bleeding has been.

post.zh: 出血型態告訴你的是機制。接下來，用 PALM-COEIN 想一遍，再去看超音波。
post.en: The bleeding pattern tells you the mechanism. Now run through PALM-COEIN, then go and scan.

lines.zh: 先經腹看全貌：子宮多大、肌瘤在哪、有沒有突進子宮腔。
lines.en: Transabdominal first for the big picture: how big the uterus, where the fibroids, whether any push into the cavity.

post.zh: 子宮腔被一顆肌瘤頂變形了。靠近內膜。
post.en: The cavity is distorted by one fibroid, close to the lining.

lines.zh: 你看到的那一顆，FIGO 分型是哪一型？為什麼它會讓她流十天？
lines.en: The one you saw: which type in the FIGO classification, and why would it bleed for ten days?

question.zh: 哪一種位置的肌瘤最容易造成月經過多？
question.en: Which fibroid position causes the heaviest bleeding?

answer.zh: 黏膜下肌瘤（FIGO 零到二型）。它突進子宮腔、增加內膜面積、干擾子宮收縮，體積不大也會大量出血。
answer.en: A submucosal fibroid (FIGO types zero to two). It bulges into the cavity, enlarges the lining surface and disturbs contraction, so even a small one bleeds heavily.

guide.en: Discuss the plan with Mrs Huang

sub.zh: 黃太太血紅素明顯偏低

lines.zh: 醫師，可以今天就開一開嗎？我明天要補貨。
lines.en: Doctor, can you just operate today? I have to restock tomorrow.

lines.zh: 抽血回來了：血紅素明顯偏低。她坐起來心跳就快。
lines.en: Bloods are back: haemoglobin clearly low. Her pulse races when she sits up.

q.zh: 今天要不要排她做子宮鏡切除？
q.en: Do you book her hysteroscopic resection today?

options.zh: 先矯正貧血、藥物止血，再排手術
options.en: Correct the anaemia and control bleeding first, then book

why.zh: 貧血不是急著開刀的理由，是先矯正的理由。穩定的病人開刀才安全。
why.en: Anaemia is a reason to optimise first, not to rush to theatre. A stable patient is a safe patient.

options.zh: 加到今天刀表最後一台
options.en: Add her to the end of today's list

why.zh: 江醫師會問你血紅素多少。然後他不會簽。
why.en: Dr Chiang will ask you the haemoglobin. Then he will not sign.

why.zh: 治療階梯要一階一階上。她還沒試過藥物和子宮鏡。
why.en: The ladder goes one rung at a time. She has not tried medication or hysteroscopy.

post.zh: 貧血怎麼補、月經怎麼先止，你來說。
post.en: How you correct the anaemia and stop the bleeding for now: you tell me.

post.zh: 好啦。那我請我兒子去補貨。
post.en: Fine. I will send my son to restock.

note.zh: 林小姐的子宮鏡切除完成

lines.zh: 黃太太的單我看到了。血紅素那個數字，我不簽。先矯正，改期。
lines.en: I saw Mrs Huang's booking. With that haemoglobin I am not signing. Optimise, then rebook.

lines.zh: ……了解。我去改。
lines.en: ...Understood. I will change it.

lines.zh: 我早上說過：階梯。好了，林小姐準備好了。
lines.en: I did say: the ladder. Right, Ms Lin is ready.

guide.en: Meet Ms Lin at the door

lines.zh: 醫師，我算過了，這顆肌瘤讓我一年請了二十四天假。
lines.en: Doctor, I did the maths: this fibroid has cost me twenty-four days' leave a year.

lines.zh: 會計師的算法。今天我們把它從子宮腔裡拿掉，不開腹。
lines.en: An accountant's answer. Today we take it out of the cavity, no abdominal incision.

guide.zh: 準備子宮鏡與灌流系統
guide.en: Set up the scope and fluid

lines.zh: 子宮鏡、電切環、進水出水管路。灌流液差額你來記，每一袋都要報。
lines.en: Hysteroscope, resection loop, inflow and outflow lines. You keep the fluid deficit; call out every bag.

q.zh: 點選子宮鏡與灌流系統所在的位置。
q.en: Tap where the hysteroscope and fluid system are set up.

post.zh: 灌流液差額歸零，開始計。
post.en: Fluid deficit zeroed; counting from now.

lines.zh: 鏡頭進去了。肌瘤在前壁，突進腔內。切除的原則，你一邊做一邊說。
lines.en: Scope is in. Fibroid on the anterior wall, bulging into the cavity. Talk me through the principles as you go.

post.zh: 差額報告：目前在安全範圍。
post.en: Deficit report: within the safe range so far.

post.zh: 好，到這裡。寧可留一點下次再來，也不要為了一次切乾淨冒穿孔的險。
post.en: Good, stop there. Better to leave a little for another day than risk a perforation to finish in one go.

lines.zh: 醫師，為什麼我的肩膀好痛？你們不是開肚子嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, why do my shoulders hurt? You operated on my belly.

lines.zh: 那是氣腹殘留的氣體刺激橫膈，痛會轉移到肩膀。幾天就會好。
lines.en: That is leftover gas from the pneumoperitoneum irritating the diaphragm; the pain is referred to the shoulder. A few days and it goes.

lines.zh: 那……你們有看到什麼嗎？
lines.en: So... did you see anything?

lines.zh: 有。十年的痛是有原因的。葉主治來了，她跟你說。
lines.en: Yes. Ten years of pain had a cause. Here is Dr Yeh; she will explain.

lines.zh: 小芸，病灶我們處理了，兩邊輸卵管看起來通暢。關於懷孕，我們來談時間。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yun, we treated the lesions and both tubes look open. About pregnancy: let us talk about timing.

post.zh: 呼叫器響了。葉主治這次沒有看，先把小芸的手握了一下。
post.en: The pager goes. This time Dr Yeh does not look; she squeezes Hsiao-Yun's hand first.

note.en: Handed over to the night team

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 小芸：腹腔鏡內膜異位病灶切除，檢體已送，肩膀痛已衛教，明天出院。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yun: laparoscopic excision of endometriosis, specimen sent, shoulder-tip pain explained, home tomorrow.

lines.zh: 林小姐：子宮鏡黏膜下肌瘤切除，灌流液差額安全，觀察出血。
lines.en: Ms Lin: hysteroscopic resection of a submucosal fibroid, fluid deficit safe, watch for bleeding.

lines.zh: 黃太太：月經過多併貧血，藥物止血與補血依醫囑，已配血，手術改期。
lines.en: Mrs Huang: heavy menstrual bleeding with anaemia, medical control and iron per protocol, cross-matched, surgery rebooked.

lines.zh: 三份紀錄，三種語氣：一個保留生育、一個精準切除、一個先別急。
lines.en: Three notes, three tones: one fertility-sparing, one precise resection, one 'not yet'.

guide.zh: 器械送消與差額表歸檔
guide.en: Instruments to sterilisation; deficit sheet filed

lines.zh: 鏡頭輕放、電切環分開裝、差額表簽名歸檔。阿寶說一號鏡頭今天表現很好。
lines.en: Scope laid down gently, loop packed separately, deficit sheet signed and filed. A-Bao says scope one behaved today.

lines.zh: 今天三個病人，哪一個最難？
lines.en: Three patients today. Which was the hardest?

lines.zh: 黃太太。因為最難的是不開刀。
lines.en: Mrs Huang. The hardest thing was not operating.

lines.zh: 對。婦科醫師最好的刀，有時候是放下的那一把。回去吧。
lines.en: Yes. Sometimes a gynaecologist's best cut is the one she does not make. Go home.

lines.zh: 醫師，黃太太一小時換了兩片，有血塊，坐起來頭暈。心跳偏快，血壓還可以。
lines.en: Doctor, Mrs Huang has gone through two pads in an hour, with clots, dizzy sitting up. Pulse up, pressure holding.

lines.zh: 我馬上到。先平躺、量姿勢性血壓、通路確認、把配好的血叫上來備著。
lines.en: On my way. Flat, postural pressures, check the line, and have the cross-matched blood brought up.

options.zh: 平躺、兩條通路、叫血、依醫囑止血、通知主治
options.en: Flat, two lines, blood up, haemostatic per protocol, call the consultant

why.zh: 活動性出血加貧血：先穩定循環、止血、讓血在手邊，再想下一步。
why.en: Active bleeding on top of anaemia: stabilise, stop the bleeding, have blood at hand, then plan.

why.zh: 一小時兩片加頭暈，不能等到早上。
why.en: Two pads an hour and dizziness does not wait for morning.

options.zh: 直接推進手術室切子宮
options.en: Straight to theatre for a hysterectomy

why.zh: 不穩定的貧血病人半夜開大刀風險最高。先穩定、止血，大多數不需要走到那一步。
why.en: A big operation on an unstable anaemic patient at night is the highest-risk option. Stabilise and control; most never need it.

post.zh: 好，血叫了，依醫囑給了。我十五分鐘量一次。
post.en: Right, blood is on its way, given per the orders. I will check every fifteen minutes.

lines.zh: 一小時後，出血減少，血壓心跳穩定。黃太太睡了，枕頭邊放著明天補貨的清單。
lines.en: An hour later the bleeding has eased and her observations are steady. Mrs Huang is asleep, tomorrow's restocking list beside her pillow.

lines.zh: （訊息）阿萍說你先量了姿勢性血壓才開醫囑。好習慣。明天門診見，我請咖啡。
lines.en: (message) A-Ping says you took postural pressures before writing orders. Good habit. See you in clinic; coffee is on me.
